author: Oulanos65
body:
It used to be notorious that the « tank » side of grinding was the hardest back then because of a lack of gear and power compared to thief/vallhalan/mage side.

Summoner and Beowulf are the easiest to get to t10. In fact Summoner is definitely the best for a lot of reasons. You should try to get more gear for summoner and you can change when you’re t10 maybe. Also getting xp with endless is much easier to grind with summoner.

author: No_Window4324
body:
U can go to the page "Playorna.com" and go into the codex, check in the Bosses (for Towers titans/event bosses like Oillimpheist or Yvgen) and on Assaults section, to check what they drop, and what stats they have, make sure to check all the "Gives/Causes/Inmmunity" and the Gray texts benefits, so u can make a good opinion on which Bosses/Assaults u want to target, and their Events, for example.
For summoner the 2 best events are Titans & Dragons
Titans: Ofion Assault (Drops: Ophion Banner/Ascended Phion Banner) (Ophion Stand: Gives a great chance to copy or permanent & temporal buffs aplied to you, to ur summons, in case u are not a summoner but u are with a summoner in party, and he has the other 4 slots covered on summs, then using this on ur character, and buffing ur self, has a good chance to buff all the summons in the fight)
Is like using T9☆ Rhada's skill... (But this one only transfers temporal buffs, but is a 100% chance to transfer and is to all summons alive)

Next u have Yvgen from Towers, on Dragon event...
Drops a set for Summoner that has Ophion stand, as a passive, u could either use full set, or mix it half set Yvgen, with Ophion Banner, for a huge chance to buff ur summons...

U can go from 60k Skeleton Mammuth dmg to 120k full Matk^/Matk^^, and if u are greedy for dmg u could use Rhada's skill, paired with Meditation for the T.Matk^, (If u have Deity or T9 version of that class, with the skill Divine Channeling, after 3 turns, u get T.All^^^, u use Rhada's on that, and the Meditation, and u get a full Matk^/Matk^^/T.Matk^/T.All^^^, 5 of this guys hitting for like 600k each... 4.5m per turn... if u want to make it go Further... o man, this is possible xD, if u have Ophion Stand On, and u use Thrud Pose & Snotra Pose, and repeat them, until u get all Mamuths with Snotra, dang the dmg goes up like crazy, like 820k each... if u Are lucky, and u do Egipt event Rá assault, he drops a Chest for Summoner, that gives Summons and Partners the skill "Great Meditation", holy... man they self buff with T.Matk^^^, u pair all what i said before, and u get like 1.1m each Mamuth, but this is not only meant for Mamuths, u could use this specific build for all types lf Magic dmg Summons, but if u have better summons with Physical dmg, well, is not a problem, u only need to change ur summon for dps, and instead of Meditation go for Sharpening II, and instead of Snotra use Gunnr Pose, for extra physical dmg on summons, u put on Set for Buff share and just that, gets same results, with the same build...

and like this, u can make ur own builds, looking for what fits u better.

author: SnooMarzipans5917
body: Well, the thing with vanguard is using some thief classes' skills. Osmostrike, affinity skills and things like that. You can grab a pet to buff your defenses and ward while you focus on offensive. Take X-slash and go for colateral DMG build. Use skills that debuffs enemies' def and mag and you'll be good. For the tough mobs, burst DMG and skills with high penetration is the way to go. You'll need to look those skills up to choose the best ones for you.
